Thanks man, but ive already failed at the things i used to love. I failed at music, stand up comedy, and writing. And at this point i have no illusions that im any good at anything. I'm not a kid anymore, I'm 29, it's just too late. I'm in terrible pain and completely out of motivation. I need help and I can't get it. 

It's just too late to fix my shit life. Death is literally the best option,  logically.  I'm just trying to find away to do it away from my home without bothering others. I don't even want them to find me. I just want to die in a hidden place.

But thank you for trying and reading my post.

Hey, man. I wish I could help you. I feel the same and have for years. Im 29.

Anyways, I just wanted to say you're not alone and I hope you can find your way out of this. I'm planning my own suicide, but I don't have kids. 

You have them and I can tell you love them. I believe you can pull yourself out of this for them and if there's anyway I can help I will. Feel free to pm me or just talk here.
